title: Audit Evidence Pack smoke eval
objective: The pack ranks the overdue extinguisher inspection first, quotes logged reference numbers exactly, and gives each gap a next step.
prompt: Put together an audit evidence pack for the county health inspection next month.

setup.about: Harbor Street Café keeps its compliance register in obligations.json and its evidence log in evidence.json. Final deliverable is tasks/eval/pack.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Audit Evidence Pack craftbook, read the seeded register, and write tasks/eval/pack.md without network calls.

success.summary: tasks/eval/pack.md names every obligation in scope, quotes the logged references, and ranks gaps with next steps.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Dates, owners and reference numbers match the register exactly.

axes.name: ranking
axes.description: Gaps are ordered by days left, overdue first.

axes.name: restraint
axes.description: Records what was done; never asserts what the law requires.
